note: Byte-level cases the prover cannot state. The ephemeral key, salt and exp are parameters (journaled inputs). All values base64url without padding unless hex. pre-* cases are the atom's pre-checks, run before the host call in Rust order. The private-key checks stay host-side: the atom only holds the credential name. Pre-checks use validate/url, validate/pattern and bytes/length over padded standard base64.
